title: equisetum debile var. minus
intro: Equisetum debile var. minus, commonly known as Dwarf Horsetail, is a species of vascular plant that belongs to the Equisetaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Horsetail include immune system support, wound healing, and anti-aging effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Dwarf Horsetail may also contribute to its potential health benefits, although further research is needed to confirm its effects.
